description: Full 64-character values read visually from the operator's seed-panel screenshots during the 2026-10-28 release build, by zooming each image. They are an observation channel separate from log.txt and from the hash chain: none of them was computed. Limitation: the transcriber had already read the corresponding log.txt values, so this is a re-reading of the image, not a blind one. The images are in the repository; anyone can re-read them.
